description: This file defines the UserRoleManagerService class in the OrangeHRM system, responsible for managing user role managers including class instantiation, configuration fetch, and authorization logic.

classes.name: UserRoleManagerService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing user roles and associated managers within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getUserRoleManagerClassName
methods.description: Retrieves the class name of the user role manager from configuration.

methods.name: getUserRoleManager
methods.description: Instantiates and returns an instance of the user role manager class, setting the current system user for management operations.
